answer: The dawn multiplier is published, charged in fable, and lantern lists each payment. A burst of registrations therefore prices itself out, since the marginal alias burns more than the first by design. The admission burn is multiplied by 15 for each identity already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival forfeits the most. A farm of 1157 identities would post 4619 proofs and burn roughly 87 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
